title: RCPC representation — shared definitions
description: Identifier types, geometric types, version fields, and the provenance record shared by every representation payload. Referenced by every other schema in this directory; declares no domain content of its own.

schema_version.title: Representation-schema version
schema_version.description: The version of the representation definition the payload conforms to. Semantic; a minor is additive-only. Distinct from the service-API version and from content versions such as `baseline_version` and `plan_version`.

baseline_version.title: Product-baseline version
baseline_version.description: The content version identifying one pinned, immutable product baseline. Every process side references one.

plan_version.title: Plan version
plan_version.description: The content version identifying one submitted plan.

run_id.title: Run identifier
run_id.description: Identifies one execution or simulation of a Behavior Tree. Minted by the Orchestration Service at run start; carried by every event of that run.

element_id.title: Product-element identifier
element_id.description: Identifies one element of the product baseline. Carried through from the imported model's GUID where the source supplies one.

task_id.title: Stable task identifier
task_id.description: Minted once by the Graph Service at product-graph construction time and carried unchanged through the plan, the Behavior Tree, every execution event, and every dispatched instruction. The sole correlation key for feedback; no schema anywhere declares a second one. The same value identifies a task in a plan version and in every run of it, so plan-versus-run comparison is a query. See representation.md section 3.

robot_id.title: Robot resource identifier
robot_id.description: Identifies one registered robot resource. Referenced from a run's task node to record which robot actually performed the task.

provenance.title: Reproducibility record
provenance.description: Carried by every derived artifact (a graph delta, a plan version, a Behavior Tree, a run's process side), recording what produced it and under which versions.

content_plugin_versions.description: The content plug-ins that participated, by name and version: the material-to-method map, the method library, importers.

producer.description: The producing component and its own version.

quantities.title: Quantity attribute map
quantities.description: An optional map an element or a task may carry. The Graph Service validates shape only (key, numeric value, unit, provenance) and never interprets a quantity's meaning. The extension point through which a second application such as Life Cycle Assessment obtains its inputs.

provenance.description: Where the quantity came from: the importer, a derivation, or a manual entry. Free text, not interpreted.

vec3.title: Three-component vector
vec3.description: Three numbers in the baseline's coordinate system. Shape only; `position` and `rotation` build on it and carry the meaning.

position.title: A position
position.description: A point in the baseline's coordinate system. Where an element sits, and where a robot is asked to arrive: the same kind of fact, so the same definition.

rotation.title: A rotation
rotation.description: An orientation in the baseline's coordinate system, ordered [rx, ry, rz] in radians.

envelope_head.title: Fields every representation payload carries
envelope_head.description: Every payload the Graph Service returns or accepts declares the representation-schema version it conforms to and, where baseline-scoped, the baseline it was read at.
